subject: Sealed depot image rotation, operator onboarding & audit response
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgecorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@edgecorp.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: sealed depot image rotation + operator onboarding for upcoming audit

Hi Jordan,

We're running up against our Q3 compliance window and the external auditor wants the sealed depot rotation and operator onboarding documented + evidence of the latest image provenance. Can Redwood confirm the current signing process for offline images, expected lead time for a key rotation, and what artifacts you'll provide for verification (manifests, sigs, checksums)?

We have an internal change freeze week of Aug 9–13; ideally we'd complete the exchange and operator rehearsal before then. Also: our SOC team needs a short runbook and a contact for the physical handoff courier.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Cloud Ops, EdgeCorp
Attachment: none
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgecorp.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, security@edgecorp.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sealed depot image rotation + operator onboarding for upcoming audit

Tom — thanks for the heads-up. We can support the full QA and audit artifacts. High-level plan below; I'll coordinate the work with Marissa and Karthik and loop you in for the runbook acceptance.

Proposed plan (summary):
- Today (Aug 4): confirm image build ID + current signing key (we are on signing key KID-rdw-202706).
- Aug 5–6: Redwood generates a rotation package: new signed manifest + new .sig for binary (signed by HSM-protected key), plus SHA256 sums.
- Aug 7: operator onboarding session (30–45 min) with on-site operator(s) or remote-operator walkthrough for sealed-depot acceptance procedure.
- Aug 8: final verification and courier handoff window (we'll provide hash pairs and verification checklist).

Artifacts you'll receive: signed manifest (JSON), binary signature (.sig), checksums.txt (SHA256), operator acceptance checklist (PDF), and an audit evidence bundle (timestamps, signer cert chain).

Questions for you now:
1) Who will be present for the operator onboarding (names/emails)?
2) Do you require HSM-backed key material transfer agreement (we support KMS/HSM workflows and can provide KMS attestations)?

I'll attach the draft runbook and proposed checklist in a followup. If the Aug 7 session needs to be in-person, tell me who the operator is and we'll arrange.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: rdw-sealed-depot-runbook-v1.pdf (draft)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sealed depot image rotation + operator onboarding for upcoming audit

Jordan / team — quick technical notes to pin down before we hand artifacts to EdgeCorp's SOC:

- Signing key rotation cadence: suggested one-time rotation now, then quarterly rolling. For this exchange we'll provision a new signing key (KID-rdw-202708) inside our HSM cluster and only export the verification cert (not private key).
- Artifact format: we'll emit manifest JSON with fields: build_id, sha256, signer_kid, signer_cert_url, timestamp, provenance_notes. Lock the schema.
- Offline verification steps: operator will verify (.sig via openssl/rdw-verify tool) and confirm SHA256 match. We need acceptance logs with operator username and UTC timestamp — include that in the evidence bundle.
- Courier process: sealed envelope + tamper-evident manifest label; we recommend a two-person receipt check and a signed operator acknowledgment PDF scanned into the bundle.

Marissa — can you own the runbook checklist items 3–7 (operator runthrough, verification script, evidence bundle packaging, and one-button audit export)?

Karthik
Sr. Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: EdgeCorp: signed manifest + courier details attached

Jordan / Marissa — attaching our inbound checklist and the named operator for the acceptance window. See attachments: edgecorp_signed_manifest_v3.json.sig (signed by EdgeCorp verifier) and courier_instructions.pdf.

Operator on site: Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgecorp.com> (will be the person doing on-site verification during Aug 8 window).

Notes: we prefer the operator onboarding to be remote — Priya will be in the secure room and can be on video for the handoff. We'll still perform the two-person receipt step.

Attachments: edgecorp_signed_manifest_v3.json.sig, courier_instructions.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgecorp.com>, security@edgecorp.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeCorp: signed manifest + courier details attached

Thanks Tom / security team — good details. Jordan / Karthik / Mina, I've updated the runbook with concrete verification commands and the evidence checklist. Highlights:
- Verification script: rdw-verify --manifest edgecorp_signed_manifest_v3.json --sig edgecorp_signed_manifest_v3.json.sig --certs signer_chain.pem
- Acceptance checklist (short): (1) Inspect tamper seal, (2) Confirm courier manifest matches manifest JSON sha256, (3) Run rdw-verify, (4) Capture operator signature + timestamp, (5) Upload audit bundle to secured drive link.
- Evidence bundle will include: signed_manifest, binary.sig, checksums.txt, acceptance.pdf (operator-signed), video timestamp token (if video recorded).

Mina — please schedule the Aug 7 operator onboarding (45 mins) and include the verification script in the invite. Priya's email is copied above.

Tom — pending your confirmation that Priya will be available Aug 7–8. If yes we'll proceed with HSM key rotation and provide signed artifacts by Aug 6 EOD.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
Attachment: rdw-sealed-depot-runbook-v1.pdf (updated)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgecorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@edgecorp.com>

Date: Fri, 5 Aug 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: sealed depot rotation schedule + evidence handoff (confirmed)

Tom / Priya — thanks for confirming availability. Final schedule and links below: 

- Aug 6 18:00 UTC: Redwood publishes signed artifacts to sealed transfer package (attachments: sealed_image_v3.tar.gz.sig, edgecorp_signed_manifest_v3.json.sig, checksums_v3.txt).
- Aug 7 16:00 UTC: 45-min operator onboarding (remote). Calendar invite sent by Mina.
- Aug 8 09:00–12:00 local: courier handoff + operator verification window. Priya will perform verification.

Audit evidence link (write-once folder): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/EdgeCorp/SealedDepot/Runbook-v1 (read-only for EdgeCorp SOC). DocuSign for the acceptance statement: https://docusign.com/s/abcdef-EdgeCorp-seal-rotation

Next steps for Priya during handoff:
1) Inspect courier seal and compare printed manifest SHA256 with checksums_v3.txt.
2) Run: rdw-verify --manifest edgecorp_signed_manifest_v3.json --sig edgecorp_signed_manifest_v3.json.sig --certs signer_chain.pem
3) Sign acceptance.pdf and upload to the audit evidence folder.

If everything verifies, we'll mark the rotation as complete and provide a signed audit bundle within 24 hours. If there are any mismatches, Priya should notify security@edgecorp.com and jordan.blake@redwood.ai immediately and we will hold activation.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
